gizmo.title: Taiwhanga Whakaahua
gizmo.description: He taiwhanga e whakaatu ana i ngā whakaahua hei mātiti, hei tahora pātū, hei whakaaturanga kiriata rānei.

configure.title: Aratau whakaatu
configure.description: Me pēhea te whakaatu i ngā whakaahua i te taiwhanga.

advanced.title: Taupū hohe
advanced.description: Taupū o te whakaahua hohe hei tīmatanga i te aratau taiwhanga.

developer.title: Ngā whakaahua
developer.description: Ngā whakaahua i te taiwhanga. Kāore e whakatikaina ki konei: ka whakamahia e te whakahuahua whārangi kia mōhio ai ko ēhea paraka ka taea te whakataka ki roto.
